run_GTestJsonOutputUnitTest: run the Google Test JSON output unit test suite to verify JSON output correctness
test_non_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with passing and failing tests produces correct JSON output
test_empty_json_output: test that a Google Test binary with no tests produces an empty JSON output document
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in JSON output is a valid ISO 8601 datetime string
test_filtered_json_output: test that applying a gtest_filter flag only includes matching tests in JSON output
